identity.name: Middle East Eye
identity.description: A UK-based digital news outlet covering the Middle East, North Africa and the broader Muslim world, with a strong focus on Palestine and regional politics.

ownership.ownershipNotes: Independent UK-based digital publisher founded by former Guardian Middle East editor David Hearst. Funding sources have been questioned by critics; the outlet denies state funding.

editorialOrientation.evidence: Independent digital outlet with critical coverage of Gulf governments and Israel; funding transparency is limited and critics allege Gulf-linked funding, which the outlet denies.
editorialOrientation.source: Ownership and self-description via Official about page; secondary references; feed-level sample

politicalLeaning.evidence: MBFC rates Left-Center and Mostly Factual; strong pro-Palestinian and human-rights framing.

economicPerspective.evidence: Economic coverage is secondary and policy-oriented, without a consistent market ideology.

internationalAlignment.evidence: Frames regional affairs through Palestinian rights and criticism of authoritarian Gulf and Israeli policies.
internationalAlignment.source: Ownership, editorial positioning and regional coverage sample

reliability.evidence: MBFC rates factual reporting Mostly Factual and credibility High; strong original sourcing, with funding-transparency caveats.

externalRatings.notes: MBFC: Left-Center; factual reporting Mostly Factual; credibility High (retrieved 2026-10-25).

intelligence.knownPerspective: Independent, Palestine-centred Middle East voice. Challenges Gulf and Israeli official narratives, with strong human-rights framing and limited transparency about funders.

selectionRationale: Provides a critical, Palestine-centred perspective that balances Gulf state-aligned and Israeli sources, with funding caveats.

research.researchNotes: Existing production mapping retained. Funding transparency remains an open question; see uncertainty register. Research is feed-level only; full article sampling and peer review remain outstanding.
